findings.explanation: This details field implies the grouped headaches, blurred vision, nausea, and confusion developed after the medication switch. The note gives distinct symptom timings: some began five days before presentation and confusion developed during treatment twenty-four hours before admission. It does not establish that the grouped symptoms all followed the switch in the asserted way.
